headword: {天照大神|あまてらすおおみかみ}
reading: あまてらすおおみかみ
gloss: Amaterasu, the sun goddess of Shinto

definitions.gloss: Amaterasu, the sun goddess of Shinto
definitions.explanation: The sun goddess of Japanese myth, the most important deity of Shinto, and in the myths the ancestor of the imperial family. She is enshrined at the Inner Shrine of Ise.

examples.japanese: {天照大神|あまてらすおおみかみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧だ。
examples.english: Amaterasu is the goddess of the sun.

examples.english: It is said that when Amaterasu hid in the rock cave, the world was plunged into darkness.

notes:
Also written {天照大御神|あまてらすおおみかみ}, as in the ⟦{古事記|こじき}→古事記：31027_kojiki⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the best-known myth, offended by her brother {須佐之男|すさのお}, she shut herself in a rock cave ({天岩戸|あまのいわと}) and the world went dark until the other gods lured her out with a festive dance. Ise Shrine (⟦{伊勢神宮|いせじんぐう}→伊勢神宮：31048_isejinguu⟧), where she is enshrined, is the most sacred shrine in Shinto.
